name: Lampas
description: A damask diaper: tall ornamental medallions over a crossed flourish, alternating with small flourishes alone, woven tone on tone.

code.style: --rule: ( @even { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 4%; width: 92%; height: 92%; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--flourish); clip-path: @var(--flourish); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12%; top: 1%; width: 76%; height: 98%; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--vase); clip-path: @var(--vase); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } @odd { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: 26%; width: 48%; height: 48%; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--flourish); clip-path: @var(--flourish); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 43%; top: 43%; width: 14%; height: 14%; border-radius: 50%; background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --vase: @shape(split: 240; x: sin(t) * (.55 + .45 * cos(4t)) * (1 - .25 * cos(t)) * .95; y: -cos(t) * .95); --flourish: @shape(split: 240; r: .55 + .3 * cos(4t) + .15 * cos(8t); rotate: 45); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
